messages:
Aisha Patel: Starting NorthStar private VPC handoff thread. They want private control plane + inference nodes integrated into their VPC. Critical: IAM assume-role, CMK HSM attestation, and Splunk forwarding. Friday target. Owners please ack with minimal acceptance criteria.
Ben Walker: I'll take networking/egress. Need peered CIDR and whether they NAT or direct egress. Also need list of Greenwood (redwood) IPs for registry/telemetry.
Aisha Patel: They use peered CIDR 10.60.0.0/16, NATed. They expect only HTTPS egress to our registry. I'll post exact IPs.
Ben Walker: For now, firewall snippet to request:
```
allow from 10.60.0.0/16 to 34.82.160.0/24 tcp 443
allow from 10.60.0.0/16 to 52.23.47.0/24 tcp 443
allow ntp udp 123 to pool.ntp.org
```
Diego Romero: I'm on KMS/IAM. Customer requires HSM-backed CMK in their AWS account and a key policy granting Redwood kms:Decrypt,kms:Encrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey, with a condition aws:SourceAccount = their-account. They also require CMK fingerprint and HSM cert before cutover.
Aisha Patel: On Splunk: they use HEC url https://splunk.northstar.example:8088 and token scoped to ingestion only. We must prove <10s end-to-end for logs. Can SRE run a smoke test?
infra-bot: task-create: splunk-smoke -> queued. id: TSK-8791
Ben Walker: Action list: 1) Ben -> final egress IPs & firewall snippet (24h). 2) Diego -> KMS key policy template + sample CMK fingerprint request (48h). 3) Aisha -> confirm HEC token & staging URL. 4) SRE -> run HEC smoke and post results. If Splunk smoke misses Fri COB, mark renewal risk. 
Diego Romero: I'll prepare assume-role template restricting S3:GetObject and kms:Decrypt and add IpAddress condition for 10.60.0.0/16. ETA 24h.
Aisha Patel: I'll schedule cutover rehearsal Mon 09:00 PT if all items clear. If any blocker persists we'll delay. Thanks.
